ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA! 

Nanatiling pansamantalang sarado ang EDSA-Ortigas Interchange habang isinasagawa ng Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) ang clearing, reinstallation ng road safety devices, at load testing bilang bahagi ng ongoing maintenance works.

Ayon sa ahensya, muling bubuksan ang interchange para sa mga light vehicles sa Lunes, Abril 27.

Samantala, magpapatupad naman ang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) ng traffic management measures habang nagpapatuloy ang mga gawain sa lugar. | DZRH News

Courtesy: DPWH

data.text:
RENEWABLE FUTURE NOW

Environmental advocates led by the Philippine Movement for Climate Justice (PMCJ) and the Asian Peoples’ Movement on Debt and Development (APMDD) marched from North Avenue to East Avenue in Quezon City on Sunday.

The protest was held in solidarity with the Transitioning Away from Fossil Fuels (TAFF) conference in Santa Marta, Colombia.

The groups called for a fossil-free future and a swift shift to 100 percent renewable energy during a global day of action.

📸 The STAR/Miguel de Guzman

ART FOR CLIMATE JUSTICE

Artist Sim Tolentino paints a mural calling for a fossil-free future as he joins environmental advocate groups in Quezon City on Sunday.

The action formed part of a global day of protest pushing for climate justice and a shift to renewable energy.
